bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import sys,urllib.request,urllib.error
url="https://api.telegram.org"
def probe(proxies):
 try:
  opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler(proxies))
  r=opener.open(urllib.request.Request(url,method="GET"),timeout=9)
  r.close()
  return True
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
  return e.code<500
 except Exception:
  return False
default=probe(None)
direct=probe({})
if default and direct:
 print("STK04_HOST_PYTHON_EGRESS=DIRECT_AND_DEFAULT")
 sys.exit(0)
if default and not direct:
 print("STK04_HOST_PYTHON_EGRESS=DEFAULT_ONLY")
 sys.exit(80)
if direct and not default:
 print("STK04_HOST_PYTHON_EGRESS=DIRECT_ONLY")
 sys.exit(81)
print("STK04_HOST_PYTHON_EGRESS=NEITHER")
sys.exit(82)
PY
